tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i 'gab 'dre bse gdong mnan thabs lcags kyi ri bo bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badzra pā ṇi ye/ ga na pa ti'i 'gab 'dre bse gdong can mnan pa'i lag len ni bon rnga lta bu'i rnga lpags rnying pa bkrus btul gtsang sbra can mtho gang tsam la khyi ra nag po gnyis kyi khrag dug ldong ros snag tsha dang sbyar ba'i gru gsum gyi nang mi lus glang po'i mgo can nag po sna dmar rkang lag lcags sgrog gis bcings pa'i gzugs bris pa'i snying gar ga du dzaḥ thad bris kyi steng du ga 'og tu dzaḥ de'i steng 'og tu thad bris kyi gnod sbyin bse gdong can a karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pa tshar re bris la rang mdun lcags slang nang re nag steng du bzhag la dar ras sogs kha dog nag po'i g.yogs gang rung gi bkab/ 'byung 'dul dang tshogs bdag gi mchod gtor bshams la/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub sogs gong ma rnams kyi gsung rab nas 'byung ba bzhin 'byung 'dul dang tshogs bdag gi bdag mdun gtor 'bul bcas grub mtshams ling khebs bsal la sumbha nis bsangs/ swā bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'brub khung gru gsum mthing nag me 'bar ba'i nang du tri las gnod sbyin bse gdong nag po mi lus glang po'i mgo can glang sna dmar po rkang lag lcags sgrog gis bcings pa rid cing nyam thag pa'i gzugs can du gyur/ rdor dril hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ bdag mdun gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer mthing nag lcags kyu lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros pas gnod sbyin bse gdong gang na gnas pa nas bkug mdun gyi liṅga la thim par bsam la/ ngag tu/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i zhes sogs/ bden bdar spyi 'gre byas mthar/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gnod sbyin bse gdong can a karṣa ya dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dang / mdzub mo gnyis kyi 'gugs pa'i stangs ka bya/ de 'dra lan gsum bdun sogs byas mthar rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngo nag drag la rtsub pa mtshon cha'i char lta bu 'phros gnod sbyin gyi lus la phog pas yan lag dang nying lag bcings/ sems rnam par myos/ dbang po'i sgo rnams bsdams/ stobs nyams shing tshar bcad par gyur ces dang / lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos/ oṃ sumbha ni nas/ bidyā rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ ga du dzaḥ mā ra ya hur thum dzaḥ ga du dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad/ ga du dzaḥ stambha ya nan/ zhes sbrel nas bdun nam nyer gcig tsam song rjes/ ga du dza nas/ rbad nan bar rkyang pa sum cu tsam bzlas/ yang sumbha ni sogs sngags spel ma gong bzhin gsum bdun sogs bzla/ de nas ga du dza sogs rkyang pa brgya stong sogs bzlas mthar thun 'phro gcod pa na/ dug dang zi ra nag po bsres pa'i thun ling snod kyi phyir ma 'thor bar brabs la/ sumbha ni dang ga du sogs spel sngags bzlas/ de nas gzhogs g.yas nas sgril la glang rog po'i rwa nang du rtse phyogs la mgo bstan nas bcug rwa gsham re bas phur/ tshon skud kyis bcings la/ oṃ wakka badzra tiṣṭha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi pa ra ga ṇi sa ma ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod la sātstsha me po can hūm̐ bzhi pa sogs gzungs byin can ci mang gzhug zhing rab gnas can gyi mnan bskal pa stong gi bar du mi thar bar bsam/ de nas gzhug chog bya/ de lta bu'i tshul gyi thun bzhir zhag grangs nyer gcig sogs rtags ma byung bar du sgrub/ 'gugs 'dren sngags bzla thun grab kyi skabs rwa nang nas phyung la lcags snod du gong bzhin bshams/ thun mtshams rnams su gong bzhin bsdu/ de ltar byas pas rmi lam du glang nag bsad pa dang / srog chags gdug pa can bcings shing g.yang la 'phangs pa dang / mi nag bsad skrad sogs ltas rnams 'byung ba dang / gong bzhin sgrub pa byas mthar liṅga rwa nang du bcug

sngar brabs pa'i thun rdzas kyis bkang / re bas kha phur/ tshon skud sngo dmar gyis bcings/ rwa yongs rdzogs la chab chu mi 'chor bar bstum la bskyed rim gsal zhing sumbha ni bzla bzhin pas sgrub khang gi lho nub brag la chu 'thab zhig tu rwa gshong ba'i dong gru gsum khru gang sor dgu'i dpangs brus la rwa rtse mthur bstan du bcug pa'i khar sngar gyi sātstsha bzhag pas 'thems par gcags la g.yam pa la rdo rje rgya gram bris pas kha bcad/ de'i phyi nas kyang sa rdos g.yogs mi mngon zhing brtan par byas la/ oṃ wakka badzra sogs gong gi sngags brgya stong sogs ci 'grub bzlas/ sems kyi dmigs pa'ang gong bzhin bya'o/ /sgrub khang du logs nas tshogs 'khor dang rjes chog bya/ de ltar byas pas tshogs bdag sgrub pas bar chad mi 'byung zhing / zhag nyer gcig gi 'grub pa dang / rang gi slob brgyud lnga'i bar la bse mnan mi dgos pa'i gsungs rgyun yang yod do/ /zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis yar klung pa dang / bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab nas 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa'o/ /'di skabs su rang dang sbyin bdag nas mchog gsum mchod 'bul/ dge 'dun bsnyen bkur/ gsung rab klog 'don/ sātstsha sil gtor/ tshe sgrub sogs bsod nams bskyed pa'i thabs la 'bad par bya'o// //zhes pa'ang gong 'phros so// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i 'gab 'dre bse gdong mnan thabs lcags kyi ri bo/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
